name: Jordan's Ore Shipment
summary: Mo'grosh ogres hold Jordan's Ore Shipment in the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. The ore came by caravan from the Wetlands for Bailor Stonehand to refine into an alloy for the smith Jordan Stilwell.

sections.title: An Ambushed Delivery
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell's ore shipment was bound for Bailor Stonehand, a dwarf who would refine it into his special alloy. The caravan carried the ore south through the mountains from the Wetlands into Loch Modan when Mo'grosh ogres ambushed it. The ogres dragged the shipment to their stronghold in the wilderness. The surviving guards perished from their wounds, and Jordan's smithing project waits until the ore is recovered.

aliases: what is in jordan's ore shipment
faq.answer: The shipment holds ore for Bailor Stonehand to refine into his special alloy for the smith Jordan Stilwell's metalwork in Ironforge.
Mo'grosh ogres ambushed the caravan as it traveled south from the Wetlands, slaughtered the escorts, and hauled the crates to their territory northeast of the Loch.
Bailor Stonehand is a dwarven craftsman stationed in Loch Modan and an old friend of Jordan Stilwell. He arranged the shipment of alloy before ogres overran it.

faq.q: Why is this shipment important to paladins?
faq.answer: Paladins undertaking the Test of Righteousness seek the alloy to help Jordan Stilwell forge a consecrated weapon of the Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, recovering the stolen alloy from the Mo'grosh ogres is a vital step in Jordan Stilwell's commission and proves your dedication during the Test of Righteousness.
As a blacksmith, you can recognize Bailor Stonehand's specialized alloy as fine dwarven metallurgy. Jordan Stilwell refused ordinary substitutes for his craft.
